description: This file defines the interface for the xrsv_ws_nextgen component, a WebSocket-based speech request handler in C. It includes macro definitions, enums, structure definitions, callback function types, handler configuration structure, and API functions for creating, configuring, updating, sending messages, and destroying the handler. The file encapsulates the interfaces for managing speech recognition sessions, handling events, and communication with a speech service.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_create
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a WebSocket-based (NextGen) VREX speech request handler instance. Returns a handle used for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_handlers
methods.description: Registers application callbacks and provides a handlers table compatible with the speech router.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_user_data
methods.description: Updates the user data pointer associated with the handler, which is passed to callbacks.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_device_id
methods.description: Sets the device identifier used in messages to the service.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_device_type
methods.description: Sets the device type, e.g., STB or TV.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_partner_id
methods.description: Sets the partner identifier for the service.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_mask_pii
methods.description: Enables or disables masking personally identifiable information.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_update_init_app
methods.description: Provides an application JSON blob included in the init message.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_send_msg
methods.description: Sends a raw message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: xrsv_ws_nextgen_destroy
methods.description: Closes the handler and frees resources.
